metal.note: First four points are training-history bin means at the recorded agent_steps; final env metrics are a separate 1024-episode evaluation. Uptime and SPS exclude that evaluation.

cuda.note: First four points are training-history bin means at the recorded agent_steps; final env metrics are a separate 1024-episode evaluation. Uptime and SPS exclude that evaluation.

benchmarks.method: Environment: 4096 agents, 8 warmup + 256 measured ticks, three repetitions, 10 threads. Train: default config except 4194304 steps, profile=1, eval_episodes=0 and output paths; PUF_METAL_KPROF=1. Threads 4 use unchanged config, threads 10 use PUF_ENV_THREADS=10.

benchmark_context: Mac mini M4, 10 CPU/10 GPU cores, 16 GB, macOS 27.0.1, clang 21.0.0. Shared machine, not exclusively reserved. Environment repetitions ran after robot-arm training completed.

robot_arm_gate.trajectory: pass in BF16 and FP32, 3 modes x 4 seeds x 5 frames
robot_arm_gate.reset: BF16 forced timeout/reset passes for all 3 modes and 4 seeds
robot_arm_gate.training_smoke: BF16 and FP32, 262144 steps each; finite weights and episode metrics
robot_arm_gate.gravity_mutation: removed joint gravity term is rejected by the same trajectory gate
robot_arm_gate.precision_invariant: CPU FP32 storage is exactly raw FP32; CPU BF16 storage is exactly RNE BF16
robot_arm_gate.precision_mutation: BF16-quantized CPU FP32 candidate observations are rejected
